newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann confirms sale of TI stake.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann confirms sale of TI stake.

text.p: Germany's Mannesmann AG said on Thursday it had sold a stake of around nine percent in British engineering group TI Group PLC.
It said in a statement that the sale had raised around 530 million marks ($347.1 million).
Earlier, London traders had reported that the stake was being placed at a price of 532 pence per share. Mannesmann confirmed in its statement that the sale had taken place today.
"For Mannesmann this represents a further step in its strategy of focusing its portfolio on the telecommunication, engineering and automotive sectors," the statement said.
It also made clear in the statement that the stake had not been sold due to dissatisfaction with TI's management.
"Mannesmann reiterates its strong appreciation of TI's management, which has achieved a very good price development for TI shares," it said.
